messages.author: dd69a5e5eb1748d7
messages.subject: Differential methylation calling with methylKit
parts:
Hello everyone,
I am new with methylKit and I'm struggling a bit to do a differential methylation on my files. I have the suspicion that it might be related to my .vcf files format but I would appreciate some input in this.

My output is obtained from BS-SNPer and I only have references to a study whose output came from BisSNP but they differ a bit and I am starting to question their validity.

Has anyone worked with BS-SNPer output and used it in methylKit before?

Thanks

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Differential methylation calling with methylKit
parts:
you can use text files that contain minimal information on methylation location and values. Here is an example: http://zvfak.blogspot.com/2013/03/using-encode-methylation-data-rrbs-in-r.html

I haven't seen that output but if it somehow doesn't work you may have to parse it to a format that might work.

Best,
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Differential methylation calling with methylKit
parts:
Hi,

I guess the function you are looking for is called `getMethylDiff()`. 
The original function `get.methylDiff` was renamed (and deprecated) a long time ago. 

Best
Alex
